title: fix(service-automation)!: the inbound hook door refuses the address of a flow slot whose package is disabled, before anything is enqueued (ADR-0150 D5)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCpddLFmKzR39wJWZpkRMCi)_
Fixes #33906

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:383-395

> **BREAKING** for a sender that posts to the inbound hook of a flow whose package is disabled while the automation engine still holds that flow's slot (the disable's re-sync failed or did not run, or the disable came with no announce). The door answered `202 Accepted`, queued the post, and the queued run was then skipped: the event was lost while the sender was told it was accepted. It now answers the door's one refusal, `401 INVALID_SIGNATURE`, the bytes the same address gets once the re-sync has withdrawn the slot. Senders that retry on a non-2xx keep the event and can redeliver after a re-enable. Remedy: enable the package; the address answers `202` again with no re-arm. Nothing durable moves, so nothing is migrated (ADR-0087: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:入站 hook 的地址指向"包已停用、但引擎仍挂着其流程槽位"的流程时,入口不再回 202 受理,而是回入口唯一的 401 拒绝(读完整个请求体之后),不入队;两种托管形态(自托管挂载与托管分发)都一样。原因只写服务器日志(`cause: 'disabled-holder'`),不告诉发送方。
- 为什么改:之前入口回 202,随后排队的运行被跳过,发送方以为已处理,事件静默丢失。按座席裁决 6898449441(方案 A,沿用裁决 6884403301 第 2、3、8 条):停用包的槽位不接受任何地址,与重同步撤回槽位后的回答逐字节相同。
- 风险与回滚:破坏性收窄(标题带 `!`),只影响"包已停用但重同步没撤掉槽位"的流程的 hook 地址;会在非 2xx 时重试的发送方可在重新启用后补投,不重试的发送方这段时间的事件会被拒收(之前是被假受理后丢弃)。共享名的裸 hook、在服务的同名包、无包流程、用槽位开关关掉的流程,回答都不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts` 的 `inboundHookSlot`(两处新判断:单一持有者分支、地址选定槽位之后)与新增的 `disabledHolderHookRefused`;测试 `packages/qa/dogfood/test/inbound-hook-disabled-holder-33906.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --project isolated --maxWorkers=2 test/inbound-hook-disabled-holder-33906.test.ts`(需先构建依赖),预期 6 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`AutomationEngine.inboundHookSlot` (both faces of the inbound hook door ask it before the signature is read) now asks `isDisabledHolderSlot`, the predicate the trigger's fire-time skip already asks (PR #33890, extended to a name one package holds by PR #34048):

- **A name two packages hold**: once the qualified address has picked its slot (the namespace's package), a slot whose package is disabled answers `unadmitted`. The slot is judged after the pick, so no other holder is served in its place (amendment 8: admission is judged on the slot that would execute).
- **A name one package holds** (the door previously answered `undefined` and judged it as before): a disabled sole holder answers `unadmitted` for every address, the bare one included.

`unadmitted` is the door's existing answer: the self-hosted mount (`ApiTriggerPlugin`) and the hosted face (`handleInboundHookRequest` in the runtime, and the `trigger-api` member for the bare hook) read the body in full and answer `inboundHookRefusal()`, `401 INVALID_SIGNATURE`. No door file changes. The engine logs the real cause at `info`, once per refused post, with `{ cause: 'disabled-holder', flow, package, slot }`; the door's own line still logs `unadmitted-address` (qualified) or `unknown-flow` (bare). Nothing is enqueued.

The question is asked at post time, so the enable serves the address again with no re-arm.

Not moved: the bare hook of a name two packages hold stays the `shared-name` refusal (PR #33646 "Not moved"); the served co-holder beside a disabled one, a flow no package ships, and a flow switched off with `toggleFlowSlot` (its address still routes to its slot: `flow-triggers-per-slot.test.ts:198-210`, untouched) answer as before.

## Tests

New file `packages/qa/dogfood/test/inbound-hook-disabled-holder-33906.test.ts` (6 tests). The rig: the real `AutomationEngine` built by the real `AutomationServicePlugin.init()` (so its flow-name resolver is the plugin's own) over a real `SchemaRegistry`; the real `ApiTriggerPlugin` mounting the self-hosted routes and registering the `trigger-api` member; the real runtime `HttpDispatcher` as the hosted face over a kernel with no `http.server`; a queue that hands each message to the trigger's consumer at once, so a run is observed. Each post is signed with the hook's correct secret, so the disable is the only reason for a refusal.

- red line: the disabled co-holder's qualified address answers the one refusal on both faces, byte-identical (status, headers, body) to `inboundHookRefusalResponse()` and to the same address after `withdrawFlowSlot` (the re-sync); nothing enqueued, nothing run; the cause is in the log only (the body names no package, namespace or `disabled`).
- red line: both holders disabled: neither qualified address is served.
- red line: a disabled sole holder: its qualified and bare addresses answer the same refusal on both faces, byte-identical to after the re-sync; nothing enqueued.
- the enable: each address answers `202` and runs again; the active trigger bindings and the queue subscriptions are unchanged (no re-arm).
- CONTROL: nothing disabled: every address answers `202` on both faces and runs.
- CONTROL: the served co-holder beside the disabled one answers `202` on both faces and runs its own flow.

The file is new rather than a describe in `flow-hook-per-slot.dogfood.test.ts` because the order names it; that file's rig mounts only the self-hosted face.

## Acceptance notes

- Skills follow-up owed: `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:383-395` (the area files that card).
- The door's own log line for this refusal names a generic cause (`unadmitted-address` qualified, `unknown-flow` bare); the engine's `disabled-holder` line beside it is the true cause. Giving the door a cause of its own would add a member to `UnverifiedPostCause` in `trigger-api` and the runtime's door text, outside this claim.
- The full PATCH-disable stack through a booted app was not measured (as in the measurement 6897225218); the armed-but-disabled state is reached in the rig with `registry.disablePackage` and no re-sync.
